subject.title: fix(discord): preserve content-type and skip optimization for animated/WebP images

question: Should this fix expand public `openclaw/plugin-sdk/outbound-media` with `preserveWebp` and `preserveAvif`, or should media preservation stay inside the Discord/current media owner path until a generic SDK contract is approved?
rationale: The PR changes a public plugin SDK subpath for a Discord-specific behavior, and repository policy treats plugin API expansion as compatibility-sensitive maintainer direction.

options.title: Keep Preservation Internal
options.body: Rework the PR to avoid new public SDK options and implement the Discord fix through current Discord/media owner paths.

options.title: Approve SDK Expansion
options.body: Allow the new SDK options only with docs, API baseline/export checks, focused compatibility tests, and explicit maintainer acceptance of the contract.

options.title: Pause For Fresh Fix
options.body: Close or pause this conflicting branch if maintainers prefer a new narrow PR against current main.

recommendation.title: Keep Preservation Internal
recommendation.body: Rework the PR to avoid new public SDK options and implement the Discord fix through current Discord/media owner paths.
